outputs_section.heading: One engine. Full‑scale software generation.
outputs_section.body: The Build Engine delivers complete, runnable products across every major category — engineered with consistent structure, clean architecture, and deployment‑ready output.

engine_section.heading: How the Build Engine works
engine_section.body: Not a code autocomplete. Not a template generator. A multi-stage autonomous agent that reasons, plans, and engineers software end-to-end.
engine_section.docs_link: Read the full Build Engine documentation

bcu_section.heading: Pay for what you build, not what you don't.
bcu_section.body: SynTract uses Build Compute Units (BCUs) — a transparent measure of the computational work required to generate your software. Simple apps cost less. Complex systems cost more. No subscriptions that charge you while you're idle.
bcu_section.meter_note: BCU consumption scales with complexity, file count, and AI reasoning depth. Top-up packs available at any time.

audience_section.heading: From solo founders to enterprise teams
audience_section.body: The Build Engine scales from a weekend prototype to a production system serving millions of users.

ownership_section.heading: You own everything the engine builds.
ownership_section.body: Every build produces clean, readable, well-structured source code that belongs entirely to you. Download it, deploy it, hand it to your engineering team, or publish it under your own brand. No lock-in. No royalties. No restrictions.

cta_section.heading: Build your first app today.
cta_section.body: Two free BCUs. No credit card. Full source code on your first build.
